comment: Add to analysis_set.json. Spreadsheet column -> schema property: de_cell_type -> cell_type, de_comparison_class -> de_comparison_class, de_contrast -> de_contrast, de_trait -> de_trait, de_trait_decoded -> de_trait_description, de_method -> de_method. Bump schema_version and add a changelog entry.

cell_type.title: Cell Type
cell_type.description: Cell type the analysis was performed in. Usable by any annotation_type with per-cell-type results (DE, peaks, signal tracks, cRE-target links).
cell_type.comment: Consider replacing with a linkTo SampleTerm (Cell Ontology) once matching terms exist in PanKbase.

de_comparison_class.title: DE Comparison Class
de_comparison_class.description: The kind of variable a differential expression analysis tests.

enum_titles.islet_function_trait: Association with a perifusion secretion or content measure
enum_titles.clinical_trait: Association with a donor clinical variable (age, BMI, sex, HbA1c, C-peptide)
enum_titles.disease_status: Comparison or association by diagnosis group (ND, prediabetes, T1D, T2D)
enum_titles.autoantibody: Autoantibody-positive vs negative, or association with autoantibody presence
enum_titles.cell_type_markers: One cell type vs all other cells

de_contrast.title: DE Contrast
de_contrast.description: The two groups compared, written as 'A vs B' in the direction of the reported fold change. Use for explicit group comparisons; use de_trait for association tests.

de_trait.title: DE Trait
de_trait.description: The variable tested for association with gene expression (clinical variable, disease status, autoantibody presence, or islet function trait code).

de_trait_description.title: DE Trait Description
de_trait_description.description: Plain-language description of de_trait, e.g. decoding an islet function trait code.

submissionExample.appscript: Insulin secretion per IEQ, 16.7 mM glucose, second-phase AUC
submissionExample.igvf_utils: Insulin secretion per IEQ, 16.7 mM glucose, second-phase AUC

de_method.title: DE Method
de_method.description: Statistical design of the differential expression analysis.

de_comparison_class.comment: DE fields are only valid on differential expression analysis sets.

de_contrast.comment: de_contrast is only valid on DE analysis sets and is mutually exclusive with de_trait.

de_trait.comment: de_trait is only valid on DE analysis sets.

de_method.comment: de_method is only valid on DE analysis sets.
